_comment: ATLAS Network config. authKeyB64 is the base64 of a reusable+ephemeral Tailscale auth key. loginServer stays empty for Tailscale cloud (set to a Headscale URL only if self-hosting). Rotate the key (it expires <=90 days) by re-encoding a new key here. Encode with: printf '%s' 'tskey-auth-...' | base64 -w0
